subject: ANGL
title: Anglais A1 (1re année)
source: Fiche de progression harmonisée nationale A1, 2026/2027

chapters.title: Module 1 – Using language to assert oneself as a responsible member of the nuclear and extended family and school community

lessons.title: Situation 1: Making new acquaintances (personal and possessive pronouns)
Situation 2: Discussing the nuclear family members (simple present of to be, to have, to do)
Situation 3: Discussing the extended family members (possessive adjectives, numerals)
Situation 4: Exploring classes and school subjects (articles a/an/the)

chapters.title: Module 2 – Using language to make informed choices on consumption of goods and services and explore jobs and professions

lessons.title: Situation 1: Identifying coins, notes, bills and amounts (demonstrative pronouns)
Situation 2: Asking for locations inside a market or supermarket (modals can/may)
Situation 3: Buying and selling goods and services (countable and uncountable nouns)
Situation 4: Finding out about common types of jobs and professions (have got; likes and dislikes)

chapters.title: Module 3 – Using language to explore times and seasons, attend to basic health and safety needs and have responsible feeding habits

lessons.title: Situation 1: Knowing the times, seasons and their activities (interrogative words)
Situation 2: Looking for and giving information on health and treating illnesses (imperatives)
Situation 3: Learning basic safety needs as a member of a health or environment club (simple past of to be, to have, to do)
Situation 4: Planning and preparing a balanced diet (sequence markers)

chapters.title: Module 4 – Using language to fulfil the rights and duties of a child and basic civic duties

lessons.title: Situation 1: Exploring the rights and duties of a child (short descriptive adjectives)
Situation 2: Finding out about birth, nationality and marriages (plurals of countable nouns)
Situation 3: Finding out about the country's emblems (present forms of regular verbs)
Situation 4: Finding out about national holidays, customs and cultural practices (past forms of regular verbs)

chapters.title: Module 5 – Using language to explore audio-visual and print media and keep abreast of modern technology

lessons.title: Situation 1: Keeping informed about local news, breaking news and current issues
Situation 2: Keeping informed about entertainment through audio-visual and print media (simple adjectives)
Situation 3: Making and receiving phone calls, SMS and e-mails
Situation 4: Using the computer
